verdict.rationale: Appwrite's auth docs say it supports implementing MFA, and it offers 30+ OAuth social providers such as GitHub, Google and Apple. Nothing in the evidence shows enterprise SSO via SAML or generic OIDC, or a way to enforce MFA as mandatory. Missing for 10: enterprise SAML/OIDC SSO support, a documented way to require (not just offer) MFA for all users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can require MFA and enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) for my application users

citations.quote: Implementing MFA to add extra layers of security to your app.
Authenticate users with existing accounts from GitHub, Google, Facebook, and 30+ other providers.
Enable 30+ social providers from the Console Social providers tab.
